name: Codeine-N-oxide
summary: Codeine-N-oxide (genocodeine) is an active metabolite of codeine. It is an opiate listed as a Schedule I controlled substance. It has a DEA ACSCN of 9053 and its annual manufacturing quota for 2013 was 602 grams.

pharmacology.text: Codeine-N-oxide (genocodeine) is an active metabolite of codeine.

uses.text: Like morphine-N-oxide, it was studied as a potential pharmaceutical drug and is considerably weaker than codeine.

summaryZh: 可待因-N-氧化物是可待因的活性代謝產物。它是一種阿片類藥物，被美國列為一級管制物質。其美國緝毒局行政管制物質代碼為9053，2013年的年度生產配額為602克。在中國大陸，該物質被列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。在台灣，該物質被列入第二級毒品。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids in general cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。一般來說，鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，過量時可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。一般来说，鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，过量时可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止。

fact.en: In an N-oxide, an oxygen atom is bonded directly to the nitrogen atom. The body can remove this oxygen again, turning the N-oxide back into its parent drug.
fact.zh: 在 N-氧化物中，氧原子直接與氮原子相連。身體可以再把這個氧移除，讓 N-氧化物變回原本的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 在 N-氧化物中，氧原子直接与氮原子相连。身体可以再把这个氧移除，让 N-氧化物变回原本的药物。
